Chapter 1110: 31 Comprehension (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 1110: Chapter 31 Comprehension (Request for Subscription)

Red Pine King eventually agreed, which slightly surprised Lin Yuan. The phrase ‘you’re quite demanding’ implied that this request was indeed a bit difficult to fulfill.

Lin Yuan had prepared to be refused and then to make another request.

Apart from comprehending the Alpha-class war machine, there were too many treasures and wonders that Lin Yuan wanted.

“Thank you, Your Highness.”

Lin Yuan said immediately, without any modesty.

The opportunity to comprehend an Alpha-class war machine is rare and invaluable.

If it were not during wartime, Lin Yuan wouldn’t even have the chance to see a war machine, let alone comprehend it.

“Do you want to comprehend the chaos secret patterns engraved on the war machine?” Red Pine King asked with interest.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

There was no need to hide this fact.

Nor was it necessary to hide it.

The most precious aspect of the war machines lies in the chaos secret patterns engraved on them.

It is precisely due to these chaos secret patterns that the power rules of thousands of Dominator realm can be perfectly integrated and then significantly amplified.

Without the chaos secret patterns, the value of war machines would be equivalent to some precious materials.

“The chaos secret patterns are bestowed by the Ancestral Founder, then replicated onto war machines by the most powerful Heavenly Venerates of our ancient country.”

Red Pine King spoke with a sense of nostalgia, “It’s a good thing that you can comprehend the chaos secret patterns.”

“I’m just taking a casual look.” Lin Yuan said.

At the same time, he also learned about the true origin of the chaos secret patterns.

Ancestral Founder.

The Ancestral Founder of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Being able to easily condense secret patterns that contain the essence of the chaos rule indicates that their attainment in the field of chaos rules has likely surpassed the limitations of the Third Realm.

Only the thirteenth stage Ancestral Founder, high above, overlooking the ancient country and even the source world, can easily condense them.

“However, you can only comprehend the war machine during this war. If the war ends, whether it’s a victory or defeat, all war machines will be sent back to the capital.”

Red Pine King reminded.

Allowing Lin Yuan to comprehend the war machine was somewhat against the rules, but Red Pine King turned a blind eye to it.

But if the war ended and the war machines needed to be called back, Red Pine King certainly wouldn’t dare to forcibly withhold them for Lin Yuan’s comprehension.

“Naturally.” Lin Yuan nodded.

…

Following that, Red Pine King chatted casually with Lin Yuan.

Mainly discussing Lin Yuan’s subsequent arrangements.

Since he had revealed the prowess of an established Great Lord, Lin Yuan naturally needed to take charge of more important defense areas.

The Ding Seven Defense Line is on the fringe; having an established Great Lord stationed there is really a waste.

Lin Yuan had no objections to this, anyway, the prowess he displayed was there; Red Pine King wouldn’t make him resist a peak Great Lord.

A moment later.

Red Pine King had mostly finished talking.

Lord Qingfen then stood up and led Lin Yuan away.

The pavilion instantly had only Red Pine King sitting there alone.

“Father.”

Just then, a young man emerged from the depths of the void,

He resembled Red Pine King by sixty to seventy percent, watching in the direction Lin Yuan and Lord Qingfen disappeared.

He couldn’t help saying, “The war machines are treasures of our ancient country.”

“Even the lowest tier of C-class war machines has important chaos secret patterns engraved on them.”

Somewhat puzzled, the young man asked, “Such an important object, Father, did you let Galaxy comprehend it just because he defeated Thunder Spear Great Honored?”

Defeating Thunder Spear Great Honored and holding the Ding Seven Defense Line was indeed meritorious, but such a reward seemed unnecessary.

Red Pine King looked at the young man, his most favored offspring, otherwise, he wouldn’t have kept him by his side during wartime.

“What do you think of Galaxy’s prowess?”

Red Pine King pondered for a moment before asking.

“Galaxy Great Lord’s prowess?” The young man was slightly stunned, “An established Great Lord? A senior Great Lord?”

“Wrong.”

Red Pine King shook his head and said, “I observed that Galaxy wasn’t proficient in the aspect of chaos evolution, and he hardly used such powers against Thunder Spear Great Honored.”

“Indeed.”

Hearing this, the young man’s expression turned contemplative.

“Galaxy Great Lord is just newly entered into the Great Lord realm; he could unleash such powerful prowess relying on the Fierce Sun Divine Body.”

“New entry into the Great Lord realm and relying on the Fierce Sun Divine Body can already unleash prowess close to a peak Great Lord. The concentration of the Fierce Sun bloodline inside this Galaxy is likely quite high.”

Red Pine King said.

The Fierce Sun Divine Body is indeed the number one constitution in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, but most Great Lords awakened the Fierce Sun Divine Body, yet none showed such exaggerated enhancement in prowess.

“I see.”

The young man suddenly realized.

“Relying solely on the Fierce Sun Divine Body to possess such prowess, if a breakthrough were achieved in chaos evolution to the senior Great Lord level, wouldn’t he be equivalent to a peak Great Lord?”

Red Pine King’s face showed a smile; maneuvering a peak Great Lord isn’t an easy task.

Many peak Great Lords are unwilling to involve themselves in the battles between the two ancient countries, directly refusing to be mobilized.

Now, Red Pine King only needed to turn a blind eye to gain the service of another peak Great Lord, making this deal natural and extremely profitable.

“Father’s considerations are indeed thorough.”

The young man’s heart was full of admiration.

If letting Galaxy Great Lord comprehend the war machine could add another peak Great Lord’s prowess to his side,

It was indeed worth it.

“As for risks?”

Red Pine King laughed, “The chaos secret patterns on the war machines are an ancient country’s top secret, but the chaos secret patterns cannot be leaked at will.”

“To leak the chaos secret patterns, one must first comprehend them. That Galaxy is just a newly appointed Great Lord; how could he comprehend the chaos secret patterns on the war machines?”

Every war machine has a ‘self-destruct’ secret pattern to prevent it from falling into enemy hands, being comprehended, replicated, and then recreated as a similar war machine.
